A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Dora-VAE and Dora-Bench study. All 17 pages, including Appendices A–D, equations, tables, figures and references, support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments and ablations in Section 4, plus image-to-3D generation results in Section 5 and Appendices B–C.

after.justification: v3 retains the original quantitative reconstruction and ablation results in Tables 1 and S2 and generation comparisons in Figures 7, S10 and S11.

M1.justification: The sharp edge sampling procedure, dual cross-attention architecture, latent representation, occupancy prediction and training objectives remain unchanged in Section 3.2 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both use the same Objaverse training data, Dora-Bench shapes from ABO, GSO, Meta and Objaverse, four geometric-complexity levels, and single-image-to-3D task. The added introductory phrase 'based on existing datasets' clarifies existing coverage.

E2.justification: Reconstruction comparisons retain XCube, fine-tuned XCube and Craftsman, with 3DShape2VecSet additionally included in Appendix B. Generation comparisons retain fine-tuned Craftsman in Figure 7 and MeshFormer, CRM and Tripo v2.0 in Appendix C.

E3.justification: The data splits, training budgets, latent sizes and evaluation procedures are unchanged. Both retain evaluation with one million sampled points, the same F-score thresholds and Chamfer distance, and SNE computed using 22 viewpoints.

E4.justification: Figure 1 retains the sampling-density comparison. Section 4.5, Table 1 and Figure 6 retain the same ablations removing DCA alone or both SES and DCA. The supplementary qualitative examples also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests for the empirical comparisons. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1 and S2 contain identical numerical results, and the plotted findings and qualitative outputs are retained. For example, the 1280-token full model's L4 F-score(0.005) × 100 remains 87.473 and SNE × 100 remains 1.579.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(12), the salient-edge and sampling definitions, geometric-complexity thresholds, and SNE definition are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The claims about sampling, dual attention, detail preservation, compact latent codes and benchmark contributions remain unchanged. Explicitly describing the benchmark as based on existing datasets repeats provenance already stated in v1 Section 3.3.1 and Appendix A, without redefining the contribution.

C2.justification: The explanations involving uniform sampling, XCube mesh-extraction errors and baseline training data remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the same limitation concerning further latent-token compression and the same future directions.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces the explicit promise to release code and benchmark data with a project-page pointer already present in v1's header. This removes release-intent information without establishing any availability change. Implementation and reproducibility details in Section 4.1 and Appendix A remain identical.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 67 references are unchanged. The relationships to prior importance-sampling methods, 3D VAEs and generation approaches retain the same positioning.

P1.justification: v3 adds brief benchmark-provenance clarifications, corrects several wording errors, updates affiliations to include LightIllusions, and adds a funding acknowledgement. The section organization and almost all prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 corrects 'Ground True' to 'Ground Truth'; Figure 6 is reduced in size and its caption is edited. Header and text reflow also change slightly. The figure and table inventory is retained, and supplementary pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: The introductory provenance clarification repeats information already available in v1, while the remaining edits mainly concern wording, attribution and layout. The method, evidence, technical documentation and limitations are unchanged. Replacing the release promise with the existing project link establishes no resource-availability change, leaving no meaningful overall gain or loss in paper quality.
